name: onebarn
description: Run your barn from ChatGPT: horses, people, daily care, health records, contracts and waivers, lessons, events, and messages, on your 1barn account.

interface.longDescription: 1barn is barn management software for boarding and lesson barns. Connect your 1barn account and ask ChatGPT what's due, who owns a horse, which stalls are open, or where the signed boarding contract for a horse is. Staff can log care, add health records, mark a horse injured, schedule service days, send documents for signature, set up event types with deposits, check people in, see bookings and open times, manage lesson terms and let the solvers propose the timetable, run the staff schedule, and message the barn. Boarders see their own horses. Every action runs under your 1barn login and the role your barn gave you.
